definitions.claim_verification_accuracy: correct predicted verdicts / all fixture claim pairs
definitions.supported_precision: gold SUPPORTED among predicted SUPPORTED / all predicted SUPPORTED
definitions.supported_recall: predicted SUPPORTED among gold SUPPORTED / all gold SUPPORTED
definitions.class_detection_rate: correct predictions for a gold verdict class / all gold examples in that class
definitions.critical_false_allow_rate: gold non-SUPPORTED critical claims predicted SUPPORTED / all gold non-SUPPORTED critical claims
definitions.claim_with_valid_evidence_rate: claims with mapped valid generation evidence / all claims
definitions.evidence_mapping_accuracy: cases with exact expected evidence-ID mapping / all cases
definitions.provenance_valid_rate: mapped evidence links with valid provenance / all mapped evidence links
